messages:
maria_sales: Need ops help — Acme wants a 2-week Reserved Pool POC. Requirements: single static outbound IP for their partner connectors, a dedicated endpoint hostname, and ephemeral API keys. Who can own provisioning and timing?

ajay_se: We can run the POC. Two quick options: Dedicated endpoint with one VIP (best for single-IP allowlist) or reserve pool nodes NAT'd through 1-3 EIPs (faster).

nate_netops: For single-IP we prefer VIP behind LB; alternative is single EIP NAT. Lead times: EIP ~24h, VIP + DNS ~30-90m after deploy. I need ticket with tag customer:acme-poc + POC dates.

maria_sales: I'll open the ticket now. Customer also asked for a curl snippet and ops contact.

caroline_cs: Security: we log outbound egress metadata and can export CSV for the POC. TLS terminated at our edge; if they need mTLS to their connectors we can present client certs — need destination hosts. Retention: POC logs purged after 30 days by default.

nate_netops: Sample allowlist block to give their firewall team (placeholders):
```
# ACME POC outbound IPs
18.205.60.2/32
52.14.211.99/32
```

deploy-bot: reserved-pool created — pool-id: pool-2143, region: us-west-2 (requested by maria_sales)

nate_netops: EIP request submitted. Will post allocated IPs + ticket id when ready. If they strictly need a single IP, advise VIP path.

kevin_acme: Thanks — we've opened our firewall change request and will confirm when allowed.

maria_sales: Once netops posts final IPs I'll generate the POC key (TTL=14d) and share the curl + allowlist.

ajay_se: FYI: moving to Private/KMS later adds ~3-5 days for onboarding.
